adults in Birmingham, with a particular focus on those from disadvantaged or fractured
family backgrounds, individuals at risk of social exclusion, and disabled children and
adults who require additional support. The Company will work to improve their educa-

ment opportunities, thereby promoting greater independence, resilience, and long-term
positive outcomes.

Sensory Pit Stops Global CIC exists to advance inclusion and accessibility for neurodiverse people,
including autistic individuals and those with sensory processing differences, by designing and
delivering safe, sensory-regulated spaces and specialist support within high-stimulation
environments such as motorsport and other major events.
The company operates for community benefit and not for private advantage, working to reduce
inequality by enabling neurodiverse individuals and their families to participate in cultural and
sporting events safely, confidently and with dignity, while also supporting event organisers to
strengthen inclusive practice through training, guidance and measurable impact reporting. Any
surplus generated will be reinvested to widen access, enhance safeguarding and accessibility
standards, and expand delivery to further events and communities.
The company’s activities will provide benefit to ...
Sensory Pit Stops Global CIC will design, deliver and manage structured sensory support
environments at motorsport and other large-scale events, providing trained staff, regulated spaces,
and practical assistance to neurodiverse individuals and their families. The company will develop
operational standards, safeguarding frameworks and training resources to support event organisers
in improving inclusive practice. Its objectives are to remove participation barriers within high
stimulation environments, promote equal access to major events, and establish a sustainable
model of accessible delivery that can be replicated across multiple venues and locations.

and churches across Scotland and the wider United Kingdom by providing
affordable, accessible AI technology solutions. The company delivers a
Website AI Assistant that enables organisations to provide 24/7 support
where visitors can type, talk to, or listen to the assistant, making it
accessible to people with different abilities, literacy levels, and preferences,
with support for over 40 languages. It also delivers a Staff Knowledge Hub
giving teams instant, trusted access to internal policies, HR procedures, and
organisational knowledge with citations to source documents. All profits are
reinvested into the community mission or used for subsidised or free access
to these tools.
